spec.title: Route each role to a reachable model whose window fits the prompt
spec.problem:
`Registry.for_role(role, exclude=..., prompt_chars=...)` in llm.py should pick, in the role's configured order, the first model that is reachable (`registry.reachable(model)` returns True; tests replace this method) and whose context window fits the prompt: a model fits when `prompt_chars / 3` is below half of `context - max_output`. Models named in `exclude` are skipped when another candidate fits (so a reviewer can prefer a model other than the coder's), but if no other model fits, an excluded model that fits is still returned. The explore role should be configured to prefer the 9B model.

Environment: commands already run inside an OS sandbox here, and macOS cannot nest one, so tests that use the sandbox (tests/test_agent.py, test_gates.py, test_mining.py, test_review_findings.py, test_tools_sandbox.py, test_workflow.py) fail in this environment whatever the change. The test command runs the hermetic test files only (test_context, test_interfaces, test_publish, test_repomap); put new tests there.
acceptance_criteria: for_role returns the first reachable model in the role's order whose window fits prompt_chars
exclude is honoured when another model fits, and ignored when nothing else fits
A prompt too large for the small model's 16K window goes to the large model
